name: Sliding VAT-inclusive salon
flags: U:staff P:fixed I:none D:fixed L:onsite Y:solo Q:none T:instant M:onsite X:vat
limitation: Gross total is right, but the schema has NO tax concept: the 1122 VAT component cannot be declared, so no invoice/receipt can break it out and a VAT-exclusive niche (add 23% at checkout) cannot be expressed at all.

name: B2B Training (VAT exclusive)
flags: U:slot P:fixed I:none D:fixed L:atcust Y:group Q:approval T:request M:invoice+comm X:vatex
limitation: No `tax` block. VAT-exclusive pricing (the norm for B2B) is unreachable: the engine quotes the net 80000 and there is nowhere to declare the 16000.

name: Tiered cancellation refunds
flags: U:room P:unit I:finite D:chosen L:onsite Y:group Q:none T:instant M:prepay X:refundtier
limitation: Cancellation is a single BINARY cutoff (`cancellationWindowHours`). A graduated refund ladder — the standard for accommodation — cannot be declared; there is no `refundPolicy[]` and no notion of a partial refund anywhere in the schema.

name: Reschedule-fee physiotherapy
flags: U:staff P:fixed I:none D:fixed L:onsite Y:solo Q:none T:instant M:onsite X:resfee
limitation: A reschedule inside the cutoff is refused outright; it cannot be ALLOWED-WITH-A-FEE. There is no `changeFee` and the reschedule path has no way to add a charge.

name: Gift voucher florist
flags: U:class P:fixed I:none D:fixed L:onsite Y:solo Q:none T:instant M:prepay X:voucher
limitation: `entitlements.plans[]` models credits/memberships but has no monetary balance, so a part-paying gift voucher cannot reduce a quote. quote() has no redemption input at all.

name: Split-the-bill supper club
flags: U:seat P:person I:finite D:fixed L:onsite Y:group Q:none T:instant M:split X:splitpay
limitation: `payments.flow: split` means staged payments by TIME (deposit/balance), not split between PEOPLE. Per-attendee billing of one booking has no representation.

name: Deposit forfeited on no-show
flags: U:staff P:fixed I:none D:variable L:onsite Y:solo Q:waiver T:request M:depbal+comm X:forfeit

name: Commission on the net, not the gross
flags: U:class P:person I:none D:fixed L:onsite Y:group Q:waiver T:instant M:prepay+comm X:commbase
limitation: `commission.rateBps` has no BASE. Whether the platform takes its cut of the net, the gross, or excludes pass-through fees is undefined — a material accounting ambiguity in every one of the 25 marketplace pivots.

name: Payout schedule to the tenant
flags: U:room P:unit I:finite D:chosen L:onsite Y:buyout Q:approval T:request M:invoice+comm X:payout
limitation: Money OUT is unmodelled. `payments.schedule[]` describes what the customer owes and when; there is no payout schedule to the tenant, so a marketplace cannot state when a business actually gets paid.

name: 18+ Wine Tasting
flags: U:seat P:person I:finite D:fixed L:onsite Y:group Q:id T:instant M:prepay X:age
limitation: A prerequisite is a yes/no gate. An age RULE (dob + minAge, evaluated at the booking date) cannot be declared — no `minAge`, and metaField `min`/`max` are numeric bounds, not date arithmetic.

name: Senior stylist premium
flags: U:staff P:tiered I:none D:fixed L:onsite Y:solo Q:none T:instant M:prepay+comm X:resprice
limitation: Priced only by abusing the generic `zone` clause. Pricing belongs to the SERVICE; there is no per-RESOURCE price or duration override, so 'this stylist costs more' and 'this stylist is slower' are both inexpressible as data.

name: Members-only squash court
flags: U:asset P:tiered I:finite D:chosen L:onsite Y:group Q:member T:instant M:prepay X:memberprice
limitation: `entitlements.plans[].discountBps` exists but quote() never reads an entitlement. Member pricing works only by hand-passing a `zone`; the declared 5000bps discount is inert.

name: Expiring credential kitesurf school
flags: U:staff P:hourly I:none D:fixed L:onsite Y:solo Q:member T:instant M:prepay X:expiry

name: Language-specific tour guide
flags: U:class P:person I:none D:fixed L:onsite Y:group Q:none T:instant M:prepay+comm X:locale
limitation: No locale/language anywhere. `terms`/`copy` are single-language, the frontend hardcodes `en-GB` in every Intl formatter, and a resource attribute cannot be made filterable — so 'guides who speak German' is neither declarable nor searchable.

name: Accessible-only bookings
flags: U:room P:fixed I:finite D:fixed L:onsite Y:solo Q:intake T:instant M:prepay+comm X:a11y
limitation: `metaFields` can DECLARE `step_free` on a resource but nothing can FILTER on it: `discovery.facets` is a fixed three-key set (price/distance/rating), so a metadata-driven facet is impossible without code.

name: Household account (one payer, many users)
flags: U:class P:person I:finite D:fixed L:onsite Y:group Q:waiver T:instant M:invoice X:household
limitation: `booking.subject` is ONE subject per booking. Three children each needing their own waiver and their own seat cannot be modelled — party size is a number, not a list of identified subjects.

name: Corporate account with negotiated rate
flags: U:seat P:tiered I:finite D:chosen L:onsite Y:group Q:approval T:instant M:invoice+comm X:contract
limitation: Customer-specific negotiated rates work only by smuggling an account key through `zone`. There is no customer-segment concept, so the tier list would have to grow one entry per contract and every customer could self-select any of them.

name: Spa Day Package
flags: U:slot P:tiered I:none D:fixed L:onsite Y:solo Q:intake T:instant M:prepay X:bundle
limitation: A bundle spanning three DIFFERENT services in one booking is inexpressible: a booking is `service_id` + contiguous slots on ONE resource. The 15000 is a hand-entered flat price with no link to its components.

name: Room requiring a projector
price: Room 4000/h, projector must be free too
flags: U:room P:hourly I:finite D:chosen L:onsite Y:group Q:none T:instant M:prepay+comm X:depres
limitation: `booking.options[]` can add a PRICE but cannot reserve a second resource. A booking that consumes room AND projector capacity simultaneously has no representation — `booking_slots` all belong to one resource.

name: Two-person massage (paired staff)
price: Per person 7000, both therapists must be free
flags: U:staff P:person I:none D:fixed L:onsite Y:group Q:none T:instant M:prepay X:paired
limitation: Requires TWO resources held for the same slot. The engine holds one resource per booking, so a paired-staff treatment can only be faked with a composite resource.

name: Airport transfer (A to B)
flags: U:slot P:unit I:none D:variable L:delivery Y:group Q:none T:instant M:prepay+comm X:twopoint
limitation: `location` describes ONE place. A journey has an origin and a destination; there is nowhere to put the second, and `serviceArea.radiusKm` is a circle around a single point.

name: Multi-day festival pass
flags: U:seat P:tiered I:finite D:chosen L:onsite Y:group Q:none T:instant M:prepay+comm X:pass

name: Sequential course (8 weeks, one enrolment)
flags: U:class P:fixed I:finite D:fixed L:onsite Y:solo Q:none T:instant M:prepay X:course

name: Waiting-list-only allotment of scarce slots
flags: U:slot P:free I:finite D:fixed L:onsite Y:solo Q:approval T:waitlist M:none X:ballot
limitation: A waitlist is FIFO by construction (`autoPromote`). A ballot/lottery allocation — random or weighted draw among applicants — has no representation.

name: Overnight shift rota
flags: U:staff P:tiered I:none D:chosen L:onsite Y:solo Q:id T:request M:invoice+comm X:midnight

name: Happy-hour crossing the boundary
booked: Booking that starts in one band, ends in another
flags: U:asset P:tiered I:none D:chosen L:onsite Y:group Q:none T:instant M:onsite X:spanband
limitation: Tier matching uses the START time only, so a 17:00-19:00 booking is billed entirely at the happy-hour rate (3000) instead of 1x1500 + 1x3000 = 4500. Time-banded pricing cannot SPLIT a booking across bands — a real mispricing, not just a missing feature.

name: Resource swap mid-booking
flags: U:asset P:unit I:serial D:chosen L:pickup Y:solo Q:id T:instant M:prepay+comm X:swap
limitation: `_resolve_selection` requires every slot in a booking to share ONE resource. A 5-day hire that swaps units on day 3 (routine in fleet operations) cannot be one booking.

name: Ferry with vehicle decks
booked: Two capacity pools on one sailing
flags: U:seat P:person I:finite D:fixed L:onsite Y:group Q:id T:instant M:prepay+comm X:multipool
limitation: A slot has ONE `capacity` integer. A sailing with independent passenger and vehicle pools (and a car consuming both) needs multi-dimensional capacity — inexpressible.

name: Restaurant turn times by daypart
flags: U:asset P:free I:finite D:fixed L:onsite Y:group Q:none T:instant M:none X:turntime
limitation: `slotDurationMinutes` is one number per service. A turn time that differs by daypart (60 at lunch, 90 at dinner) cannot be declared without splitting into two services.

name: Cleaner's travel time between jobs
flags: U:staff P:hourly I:none D:chosen L:atcust Y:solo Q:none T:instant M:invoice+comm X:travelbuf
limitation: `bufferMinutes` is a FIXED pad applied at slot creation. Travel time between two at-customer jobs depends on the distance between them — a dynamic buffer the schema cannot express.

name: Peak-season capacity increase
flags: U:class P:person I:finite D:fixed L:onsite Y:group Q:none T:season M:prepay X:varcap
limitation: `timing.seasons[]` can gate availability on/off but carries no OVERRIDES. A season that changes capacity (or price, or duration) has nowhere to say so — seasons are a boolean window, not a settings layer.

name: Last-minute discount
flags: U:slot P:tiered I:none D:fixed L:onsite Y:solo Q:none T:instant M:prepay+comm X:lastmin
limitation: No `appliesWhen` clause reads the gap between NOW and the slot START. Last-minute (and its mirror, early-booking) discounts — a staple of yield management — can only be faked by passing a `zone` the customer could choose themselves.

name: Overbooking-tolerant clinic
flags: U:staff P:fixed I:none D:fixed L:onsite Y:solo Q:intake T:instant M:invoice X:overbook
limitation: Capacity is a hard ceiling (`available_count >= party`). Deliberate overbooking — standard where no-shows are predictable — needs an overbook allowance the schema does not have.

name: Opening hours per weekday
flags: U:staff P:fixed I:none D:fixed L:onsite Y:solo Q:none T:blackout M:onsite X:hours
limitation: `blackouts[]` are DATE RANGES. Recurring weekly opening hours (closed Mondays, open late Thursdays) — the single most common scheduling fact about any business — cannot be declared; they exist only implicitly in which slots got seeded.

name: Two-week notice with a hard horizon
flags: U:staff P:fixed I:none D:fixed L:remote Y:solo Q:approval T:request M:prepay X:horizon

name: Per-tenant commission override
booked: Anchor tenant on a better rate
flags: U:slot P:fixed I:none D:fixed L:onsite Y:solo Q:none T:instant M:prepay+comm X:commoverride
limitation: `tenancy` is not overridable per service — now DELIBERATELY so, and enforced: the write path rejects it, because a tenant setting its own `commission.rateBps` would be privilege escalation. Negotiating a different rate with an anchor tenant is therefore still a code change; doing it properly needs a platform-side per-tenant commission table, not a config override.

name: Tenant-set cancellation policy
booked: Each business sets its own window
flags: U:room P:hourly I:finite D:chosen L:onsite Y:group Q:none T:instant M:prepay+comm X:tenantpolicy

name: Zero-duration instant service
flags: U:slot P:fixed I:none D:fixed L:pickup Y:solo Q:none T:instant M:onsite X:zerodur

name: Very large party buyout
flags: U:class P:person I:finite D:fixed L:onsite Y:buyout Q:approval T:request M:invoice+comm X:bigparty

name: Free cancellation, paid rebooking
flags: U:seat P:fixed I:finite D:fixed L:onsite Y:solo Q:none T:instant M:prepay X:flexfare
limitation: One `cancellationCutoffHours` governs BOTH cancel and reschedule (`within_cutoff` is shared). A fare that is freely cancellable but charges to rebook — or the reverse — cannot be expressed.

name: Deposit that is not part of the price
flags: U:asset P:unit I:rentable D:chosen L:pickup Y:solo Q:id T:instant M:depbal X:bond

name: Cross-border marketplace, mixed currencies
booked: Tenants price in their own currency
flags: U:slot P:fixed I:none D:fixed L:onsite Y:solo Q:none T:instant M:prepay+comm X:multicur
limitation: Per-tenant currency works, but nothing aggregates across currencies: provider `priceFromMinorUnits` picks a min across services regardless of currency, and search price sort/filter compares raw integers — so CHF 85 sorts against HUF 8500.

name: Same-day pivot: config swap under load
flags: U:slot P:fixed I:none D:fixed L:onsite Y:solo Q:none T:instant M:prepay X:pivotswap
